title: fix(fields): a read-only NumberField renders through the cell's formatter (objectui#11431)
body:
Fixes #11431

Clause-②: no

## What changed

A read-only `NumberField` printed the raw stored value, so a field `{ type: 'number', readonly: true, scale: 2 }` holding `1234.5` read `1234.5` in a read-only form while `NumberCellRenderer` read the same field `1,234.50`. The read-only face had no width, no grouping and no display locale.

The cell's assembly moves into one pure module, `packages/fields/src/widgets/number-format.ts`. That assembly is the width from `resolveFieldScale` (ruling A′, objectstack-ai/objectstack#19628), the field's `useGrouping` over the `scale` heuristic (objectui#4033 / objectui#11026), the two fraction-digit arms and `formatDisplayNumber`. Both faces now call `formatNumberFieldValue(value, field, locale)`:

- `NumberCellRenderer` keeps its blank and not-a-number handling and calls the helper for the number. Its output is unchanged: the four `NumberCellRenderer.*` suites are green, untouched.
- `NumberField`'s read-only branch calls the helper with `useDisplayLocale()`. The hook sits before the read-only return, beside `useBadInputRefusal` (objectui#6780). Only a `number` is formatted, as the widget's value type declares; anything else still renders as it arrives, so nothing is coerced into a digit the record does not hold. `null` still shows the placeholder.

The form and the table agree by construction, and there is no second formatter. The helper is a separate pure module, not a barrel export, for the reason `address-format.ts` and `coerceToSafeValue.ts` give: the lazily loaded widget cannot import the barrel. No exported name, type, prop or schema moves.

## Measured (real `SchemaRenderer`, real form renderer, real `@object-ui/fields` registration)

New pin `packages/fields/src/__tests__/NumberField.readonlyDisplay-11431.test.tsx`, run first on the unfixed tree (BASE `d8edfe257`). I predicted the directions before the run and wrote them in the file header:

- `scale: 2`, 1234.5 reads `1,234.50`: RED before (`1234.5`), green after.
- no `scale`, 3.14159 reads `3.14159`: the control, green before and after (no width is imposed when none is declared).
- no stored value reads the placeholder, never a digit: green before and after.
- parity: the read-only text equals `NumberCellRenderer`'s text for five declarations (`scale: 2`, none, `scale: 0` ordinal, `scale: 0` + `useGrouping: true`, `useGrouping: false`) in `en` and `de`. Before the fix, 8 of the 10 rows were RED (for example `de` `scale: 2`: `1234.5` against `1.234,50`). The 2 green rows are the ones where the raw text already equals the cell's text (`2026` ordinal, and `12345.5` with grouping off in `en`).

Before: `Tests 8 failed | 5 passed (13)`. After: `Tests 13 passed (13)`.

## Ablation (one-off, not left in the tree)

On the committed fix `792088d2f`, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) replaced the read-only call with the raw `{value}`. Anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `0a26967c730c` to `3b7ecc545515`, with a shell `trap` restoring to `HEAD` as the crash path. The pin read `Tests 8 failed | 5 passed (13)`: the `scale: 2` pin was red and the control and placeholder stayed green, the same split as the base tree. The restore was proven: blob equal to the `HEAD` blob `0a26967c730c`, and `git diff HEAD` empty. The direction was the expected one (red). No `dist` leg was needed: the pin imports the widget by relative path, and vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`.

## Tests and gates (all at `792088d2f`, the final commit)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/NumberField.readonlyDisplay-11431.test.tsx`: `Tests 13 passed (13)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/`: `Test Files 229 passed | 1 skipped (230)`, `Tests 3547 passed | 7 skipped (3554)`.
- Tests elsewhere that render a read-only number field. I found them by grepping for `readonly: true` together with `type: 'number'`: `plugin-detail` `inlineEditTypeNarrowing`, `plugin-form` `fieldSecurityPayload` and `autoLayout`, `types` `record-highlights-fields-icon-9280`, plus `examples/schema-catalog` `fields-number-scale-11413`. Result: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 87 passed (87)`.
- A form-level read-only mode also reaches this branch, so I ran the whole suites: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/ packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 388 passed | 1 skipped (389)`, `Tests 4121 passed | 9 skipped (4130)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/fields^...'`: exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows the new pin and `number-format.ts` in the test program, and all three source files in the build program.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: OK with `.changeset/11431-readonly-number-scale.md` (`@object-ui/fields` patch).
- eslint over the 4 changed TS files, a narrowed run: 0 errors.
  - Population: eslint's own `--print-config` for each file shows them linted by the root config, with no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it did not touch.
  - Counts, from `--format json`: 4 files, 0 errors. Warnings per file against BASE through `--stdin`: `index.tsx` 138 before, 137 after (one `no-explicit-any` left with the removed `as any` cast), `NumberField.tsx` 1 before and 1 after, both new files 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The docs page `content/docs/fields/number.mdx` describes only the cell face; no sentence there becomes false. A one-line note that the read-only form now matches the cell could be added by a docs pass; it is not in this file surface.
- Boundary: a number field value that arrives as a STRING (off the widget's declared value type) still renders as it arrives in the read-only face, while the cell coerces it. That is a producer question (AGENTS.md #0.1), not a reason to coerce here.
- Sibling read-only faces were measured through the same real form against their cells; they are reported to the seat, not changed here. Percent with `scale: 2` holding 0.25 in `de` reads `25.00%` against the cell's `25,00 %`. Currency with fixed USD holding 3456 in `en` reads `$3,456.00` against the cell's `$3,456`.
